info.title: FRAME Broadcast Activity Dashboard
info.description: Provider-independent structured activity publishing. For AI agents, use a registered producer bearer token and Producer-tagged operations: getCapabilities, getCurrentSession, getSessionContext, validateChanges, submitChanges and producerHeartbeat. Discover current grants before submitting viewer-facing text. All protected mutations enforce server-side scopes and revisions. Cookie-authenticated operator writes require X-CSRF-Token from /admin/me or login. No LLM, microphone, camera, OBS-control, URL fetching or arbitrary execution.

servers.description: Resolve against the dashboard origin serving /openapi.json; override with the dashboard computer address when importing a local file.

post.summary: Inspect actual visible candidate text at fixed pixel dimensions
post.description: Read-only, scope-filtered simulation with normal ChangeSet validation. Optional widgets inspect a candidate complete layout and require canProposeLayouts; content remains session/field scoped. Browser renders exact width/height, reports fully visible Unicode code-point ranges [start,end), font sizes, field/widget rectangles, overlap and clipping. Scroll is frozen at its first frame. Omitted fields are unbound, hidden, empty or outside producer grants. Never creates proposal, receipt, locks or publication. Snapshot is hypothetical even during hold/hidden; sessionRevision/configRevision identify the inspected version. Optional PNG is private. Requires installed Chromium, built render bundle. At most two concurrent inspections; RENDER_BUSY=429, RENDER_UNAVAILABLE=503. Browser/font differences from OBS can affect pixels.

post.summary: Validate and compare without mutations
post.description: Creates no session changes, locks, proposal, receipt or publication. Actual submission repeats all checks. An existing matching successful receipt may be returned as replay. Read capabilities, current session and scoped context first. Replace example IDs, baseRevision and timestamps with current values; generate a fresh UUID for a new logical update. Prefer intent=propose for review; apply requires apply_allowed policies for all affected sources and producer publishing grants. A lost submission response requires replaying the identical request ID and body.
